NONE: 極壞的；惡劣的；糟糕的；令人極不愉快的

example: He suffered awful injuries in the crash.
他在車禍中受了重傷。
We had awful weather.
我們碰上了糟糕的天氣。
She has an awful boss.
她的老闆極難相處。
What an awful thing to say!
說出這種話，太不像話了！
Would life be so awful without a car?
沒有車，日子就那難過嗎？
The food was awful.
這食物糟糕透頂。
She'd been ill and she looked awful.
她一直在生病，面色極差。
I don't know an awful lot (= very much) about art, but I'm learning.
我對藝術知道的不是特別多，但是我正在學習。
Fortunately it won't make an awful lot of difference if I don't pass the test.
幸好，我就是過不了考試也沒有太大的關係。
It was an awful risk to take.
那樣做太冒險了。

NONE: › US informal also awful very or extremely, when used before an adjective or adverb

example: It's an awfully long time since we last saw each other.
我們很久沒有見面了。
I'm awfully sorry, but we've forgotten to reserve you a table.
實在抱歉，我們忘記為您預訂餐桌了。
England played awfully throughout the game.
英格蘭隊整場比賽踢得一塌糊塗。
